profile.sourceInventory: Explicit superset, not every pinned source file executed.

boundaries.purpose: actual vision:true public runner and actual source Brain on the same earned immutable full Schema history; private Memory reads are audit data only
boundaries.openLoop: actual commands recorded/refused and never applied to World; no closed-loop policy/humanizer acceptance/survival/game outcome claim
boundaries.drivers: network and default four-phase manager source-schedule models, not socket or actual BotManager lifecycle/startup-contention execution
boundaries.clock: fixed source timestamps/declared zero-jitter replay, not physical performance or wall-clock network timing
boundaries.privacy: no hidden pair, intended-rule/sourcebug decision, public lifetime/ID contract, native/P15/ABI/budget/tag/main admission

provenance.mode: unchanged canonical capture re-execution with passive copy-before-decode instrumentation
provenance.decoderInstrumentation: Decoder.prototype.decode copies the supplied Uint8Array and calls the original method with the same receiver and arguments; it does not alter bytes or return values.

priorMethodReference.classification: derived only from captured source returns; never an input to World or consumers
priorMethodReference.counterexampleBoundary: If the flag is true, it is a producer-consistent counterexample to treating minimap omission as authoritative death. It is not a source-bug or intended-behavior classification, hidden-death/replacement equivalence, or private-ID publication approval.

observerNoninterference.comparison: every recorded public Frame/pre-post Percept/original tick return/adapter attempt/runner result/log/goal/stat; no field normalization or identity renaming

offSummary.boundary: derived source-call observations only; no expected belief or conclusion is installed into the Brain or World

offProvenance.brainRng: actual source derive tags0/1/2 and separate Knowledge3; no stream substituted or inspected
offProvenance.cadence: network every-patch MODEL over the immutable source snapshots; no actual socket or network timing execution

heldFxCap.classification: modeled undelivered FX retention, not a producer bound

offProvenance.publication: fresh actual Schema Decoder per snapshot; selected states alone enter actual runner; each selected call receives actual batches held in original order
offProvenance.recording: identical passive original-tick/ring/log/adapter wrappers in observer OFF and ON; original returns and composed objects are forwarded unchanged
offProvenance.memoryObservation: no inspector session and no Memory getter reads
offProvenance.sessionObservation: ON temporarily forwards Session.prototype.connect unchanged to retain only the helper's actual Session, restores it immediately, then checks real post rejection after helper.close; no Session is created in OFF
offProvenance.inputHash: SHA256 of ordered explicit-data JSON; preserves undefined, signed zero/nonfinite numbers and collection order; no ID renaming or sorting
offProvenance.scope: open-loop actual source caller witness; adapter records/refuses every command and applies nothing to World; no validated action, full match policy, survival, live-driver lifecycle or humanizer acceptance claim
